words.definition: A living creature such as a dog, bird or fish.
A tiny sea animal that often lives in a large group.
Different from usual in a way that makes it important or memorable.
The form of a word used for more than one.
The amount you get when you add all the parts together.
The same in amount, size or value.
On the outside of something, or coming from outside it.
More than two, but usually not a large number.
A solid whose tiny parts are arranged in a regular pattern.
Relaxed and suited to an ordinary occasion.
The city where a country's or region's government is based.
A place where doctors and nurses care for people who are ill or injured.
Found in nature or happening without being made by people.
A book where you write down what happens, what you think or what you notice.
An event or period when people celebrate something together.
The main church of the area a bishop looks after.
